financial_dialogue_policy: Use all eligible original bank/payment dialogues; additional support logs require a financial subject and a valid extractable target.
selection_policy: Prefer new target values; never use model predictions or performance. Reject cross-split source-case, name, address, identity, phone, email, account, birth-date, hire-date or salary collisions. Select unique name/birth/hire/salary values in structured records when available. Report finite-category overlap.
augmentation_policy: Keep native text unchanged. Add only missing targets, mark every addition as cross-source synthetic augmentation, preserve original donor values and source references. Do not use the restricted AI4Privacy source.
name_policy: Every name has three reversible components. Use source components when present; otherwise add explicitly labelled rule-based source-order segmentation. Never invent a missing name component.
question_policy: English extractive questions. Training uses name components and unambiguous ISO birth-date components. Evaluation retains components and adds an independent full-name question. No answer choices or private values in questions.
source_routing_policy: Use source domain plus explicit document purpose. Employment contracts, payroll, employment verification, onboarding and employee records may be routed to HR even when their publisher domain is broader.
